capabilities: apply animated background effects (Matrix rain, rain, circles, snow, star sky, wave)
set a static wallpaper image from a vault path
combine an effect with a wallpaper
control wallpaper blur and effect brightness
choose effects matched to the dark or light base theme
extras: Wallpapers must be image files inside the vault, referenced by relative path; effect availability differs between dark and light themes.
problem: Obsidian's editor background is static by default, with no built-in way to use animated effects or wallpaper images.
summary: Appearance plugin that adds animated background effects (Matrix rain, snow, waves) or static wallpapers to the Obsidian editor.
